talents.name: Wand Specialization
talents.desc_rank1: Increases your damage with Wands by 13%.
talents.desc_max: Increases your damage with Wands by 25%.

talents.name: Improved Channeling
talents.desc_rank1: Gives your Arcane Missiles spell a 20% chance and your Arcane Blast and Arcane Wrath spells a 14% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.
talents.desc_max: Gives your Arcane Missiles spell a 100% chance and your Arcane Blast and Arcane Wrath spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

talents.name: Arcane Resilience
talents.desc_rank1: Increases your Armor by an amount equal to 25% of your Intellect.
talents.desc_max: Increases your Armor by an amount equal to 75% of your Intellect.

talents.name: Arcane Subtlety
talents.desc_rank1: Reduces your target's resistance to all your spells by 8 and reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by 15%.
talents.desc_max: Reduces your target's resistance to all your spells by 15 and reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by 30%.

talents.name: Magic Absorption
talents.desc_rank1: Increases all your resistances by 5 and causes all spells you fully resist to restore 1% of your total mana. Cannot trigger more often than 1 time per sec.
talents.desc_max: Increases all your resistances by 10 and causes all spells you fully resist to restore 2% of your total mana. Cannot trigger more often than 1 time per sec.

talents.name: Arcane Concentration
talents.desc_rank1: Gives you a 2% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage spell hits a target. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.
talents.desc_max: Gives you a 10% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage spell hits a target. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.

talents.name: Missile Barrage
talents.desc_rank1: Gives your Arcane Blast spell a 20% chance, and your Arcane Wrath, Fireball, Frostbolt, and Frostfire Bolt spells a 10% chance to reduce the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 50%, reduce the Mana cost by 100%, and missiles fire every 0.5 sec.
talents.desc_max: Gives your Arcane Blast spell a 40% chance, and your Arcane Wrath, Fireball, Frostbolt, and Frostfire Bolt spells a 20% chance to reduce the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 50%, reduce the Mana cost by 100%, and missiles fire every 0.5 sec.

talents.name: Arcane Geometry
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the range of your Arcane spells by 3 yards.
talents.desc_max: Increases the range of your Arcane spells by 6 yards.

talents.name: Arcane Impact
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the critical strike chance of your Arcane spells by 2%.
talents.desc_max: Increases the critical strike chance of your Arcane spells by 6%.

talents.name: Arcane Blast
talents.desc_rank1: Blasts the target with energy, dealing 36 Arcane damage. Each time you cast Arcane Blast, you gain 12% of your Intellect as Spell Damage and the mana cost of Arcane Blast is increased by 100%. Effect stacks up to 4 times and lasts 18 sec from time of initial application.
talents.desc_max: Blasts the target with energy, dealing 36 Arcane damage. Each time you cast Arcane Blast, you gain 12% of your Intellect as Spell Damage and the mana cost of Arcane Blast is increased by 100%. Effect stacks up to 4 times and lasts 18 sec from time of initial application.

talents.name: Arcane Shielding
talents.desc_rank1: Decreases the Mana lost per point of damage taken when your Mana Shield spell is active by 17% and increases the resistances granted by your Mage Armor spell by 25%.
talents.desc_max: Decreases the Mana lost per point of damage taken when your Mana Shield spell is active by 33% and increases the resistances granted by your Mage Armor spell by 50%.

talents.name: Improved Counterspell
talents.desc_rank1: Your Counterspell also Silences the target for 2 sec.
talents.desc_max: Your Counterspell also Silences the target for 4 sec.

talents.name: Arcane Meditation
talents.desc_rank1: Allows 17% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.
talents.desc_max: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.name: Arcane Wrath
talents.desc_rank1: Launches a projectile of pure Arcane energy at the enemy target, causing 134 Arcane damage. This spell gains additional Spell Damage equal to 5% of your maximum Mana.
talents.desc_max: Launches a projectile of pure Arcane energy at the enemy target, causing 134 Arcane damage. This spell gains additional Spell Damage equal to 5% of your maximum Mana.

talents.name: Presence of Mind
talents.desc_rank1: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.
talents.desc_max: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.

talents.name: Arcane Mind
talents.desc_rank1: Increases your Intellect by 2% and increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane spells by 20%.
talents.desc_max: Increases your Intellect by 10% and increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane spells by 100%.

talents.name: Arcane Instability
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the damage done by your spells by 1% and your critical strike chance by 1%.
talents.desc_max: Increases the damage done by your spells by 3% and your critical strike chance by 3%.

talents.name: Arcane Power
talents.desc_rank1: For the next 15 sec, your spells deal 30% more damage while costing 30% more mana to cast.
talents.desc_max: For the next 15 sec, your spells deal 30% more damage while costing 30% more mana to cast.

talents.name: Incineration
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire Blast, Ice Lance, Arcane Blast, and Scorch spells by 2%.
talents.desc_max: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire Blast, Ice Lance, Arcane Blast, and Scorch spells by 10%.

talents.name: Accelerant
talents.desc_rank1: Reduces the casting time of your Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, and Arcane Wrath spells by 0.1 sec.
talents.desc_max: Reduces the casting time of your Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, and Arcane Wrath spells by 0.5 sec.

talents.name: Ignite
talents.desc_rank1: Your critical strikes from Fire damage spells cause the target to burn for an additional 8% of your spell's damage over 4 sec.
talents.desc_max: Your critical strikes from Fire damage spells cause the target to burn for an additional 40% of your spell's damage over 4 sec.

talents.name: Flame Throwing
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the range of your Fire spells by 3 yards.
talents.desc_max: Increases the range of your Fire spells by 6 yards.

talents.name: Impact
talents.desc_rank1: Gives your Fire spells a 3% chance to stun the target for 2 sec.
talents.desc_max: Gives your Fire spells a 10% chance to stun the target for 2 sec.

talents.name: Burning Soul
talents.desc_rank1: Gives your Fire spells a 23% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage and reduces the threat caused by your Fire spells by 10%.
talents.desc_max: Gives your Fire spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage and reduces the threat caused by your Fire spells by 30%.

talents.name: Improved Flamestrike
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the critical strike chance of your Flamestrike spell by 5%.
talents.desc_max: Increases the critical strike chance of your Flamestrike spell by 15%.

talents.name: Pyroblast
talents.desc_rank1: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 116 Fire damage and an additional 44 Fire damage over 12 sec.
talents.desc_max: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 116 Fire damage and an additional 44 Fire damage over 12 sec.

talents.name: Improved Fire Blast
talents.desc_rank1: Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast spell by 1 sec and increases its range by 8 yards.
talents.desc_max: Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast spell by 2 sec and increases its range by 15 yards.

talents.name: Improved Scorch
talents.desc_rank1: Your Scorch spell has a 33% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to Fire damage. This vulnerability increases all Fire damage you deal to your target by 3% and lasts 30 sec, stacking up to 5 times.
talents.desc_max: Your Scorch spell has a 100% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to Fire damage. This vulnerability increases all Fire damage you deal to your target by 3% and lasts 30 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

talents.name: Improved Fire Ward
talents.desc_rank1: Causes your Fire Ward to have a 10% chance to reflect Fire spells while active.
talents.desc_max: Causes your Fire Ward to have a 20% chance to reflect Fire spells while active.

talents.name: Heating Up
talents.desc_rank1: Non-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch reduce the cast time of your next Pyroblast cast within 20 sec by 25%, stacking up to 3 times. Fire Blast grants an additional stack every time it deals damage.
talents.desc_max: Non-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch reduce the cast time of your next Pyroblast cast within 20 sec by 25%, stacking up to 3 times. Fire Blast grants an additional stack every time it deals damage.

talents.name: Master of Elements
talents.desc_rank1: Your Fire and Frost critical strikes will refund 10% of their base mana cost.
talents.desc_max: Your Fire and Frost critical strikes will refund 30% of their base mana cost.

talents.name: Critical Mass
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire spells by 2%.
talents.desc_max: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire spells by 6%.

talents.name: Blast Wave
talents.desc_rank1: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 169 Fire damage, and Dazing them for 50% reduced movement speed for 6 sec.
talents.desc_max: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 169 Fire damage, and Dazing them for 50% reduced movement speed for 6 sec.

talents.name: Fire Power
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by 1% per your Fire effects on the target, up to a maximum increase of 4%. Effects which mix multiple schools of magic do not qualify.
talents.desc_max: Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by 3% per your Fire effects on the target, up to a maximum increase of 12%. Effects which mix multiple schools of magic do not qualify.

talents.name: Combustion
talents.desc_rank1: When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%. This effect lasts until you have caused 3 non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.
talents.desc_max: When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%. This effect lasts until you have caused 3 non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.

talents.name: Frost Warding
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the Armor and resistances granted by your Frost Armor and Ice Armor spells by 15%, gives your Frost Ward a 10% chance to negate the warded damage spell, and increases the amount absorbed by your Ice Barrier and Frost Ward by 10%.
talents.desc_max: Increases the Armor and resistances granted by your Frost Armor and Ice Armor spells by 30%, gives your Frost Ward a 20% chance to negate the warded damage spell, and increases the amount absorbed by your Ice Barrier and Frost Ward by 20%.

talents.name: Improved Frostbolt
talents.desc_rank1: Reduces the casting time of your Frostbolt spell by 0.1 sec.
talents.desc_max: Reduces the casting time of your Frostbolt spell by 0.5 sec.

talents.name: Precision
talents.desc_rank1: Improves your chance to hit with all spells by 2%.
talents.desc_max: Improves your chance to hit with all spells by 6%.

talents.name: Ice Shards
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Frost spells by 20%.
talents.desc_max: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Frost spells by 100%.

talents.name: Frostbite
talents.desc_rank1: Gives your Chill effects a 5% chance to Freeze the target for 5 sec.
talents.desc_max: Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to Freeze the target for 5 sec.

talents.name: Improved Frost Nova
talents.desc_rank1: Reduces the cooldown of your Frost Nova spell by 2 sec.
talents.desc_max: Reduces the cooldown of your Frost Nova spell by 4 sec.

talents.name: Permafrost
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the duration of your Chill effects by 11% and reduces the target's speed by an additional 3%.
talents.desc_max: Increases the duration of your Chill effects by 33% and reduces the target's speed by an additional 10%.

talents.name: Frost Channeling
talents.desc_rank1: Reduces the mana cost of your Frost spells by 5% and reduces the threat caused by your Frost spells by 10%.
talents.desc_max: Reduces the mana cost of your Frost spells by 15% and reduces the threat caused by your Frost spells by 30%.

talents.name: Improved Blizzard
talents.desc_rank1: Adds a Chill effect to your Blizzard spell. This effect lowers the target's movement speed by 15% for 1.5 sec.
talents.desc_max: Adds a Chill effect to your Blizzard spell. This effect lowers the target's movement speed by 40% for 1.5 sec.

talents.name: Ice Lance
talents.desc_rank1: Deals 31 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets.
talents.desc_max: Deals 31 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets.

talents.name: Arctic Reach
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the range of your Frostbolt, Ice Lance, and Blizzard spells and the radius of your Frost Nova and Cone of Cold spells by 10%.
talents.desc_max: Increases the range of your Frostbolt, Ice Lance, and Blizzard spells and the radius of your Frost Nova and Cone of Cold spells by 20%.

talents.name: Ice Block
talents.desc_rank1: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.
talents.desc_max: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

talents.name: Shatter
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the critical strike chance of all your spells against Frozen targets by 17%.
talents.desc_max: Increases the critical strike chance of all your spells against Frozen targets by 50%.

talents.name: Improved Cone of Cold
talents.desc_rank1: Increases the damage dealt by your Cone of Cold spell by 12%.
talents.desc_max: Increases the damage dealt by your Cone of Cold spell by 35%.

talents.name: Cold Snap
talents.desc_rank1: Finishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells.
talents.desc_max: Finishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells.

talents.name: Fingers of Frost
talents.desc_rank1: Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to grant you the Fingers of Frost effect, which treats your next 1 spell cast as if the target were Frozen. Lasts 15 sec.
talents.desc_max: Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to grant you the Fingers of Frost effect, which treats your next 2 spells cast as if the target were Frozen. Lasts 15 sec.

talents.name: Winter's Chill
talents.desc_rank1: Gives your Frostbolt and Fingers of Frost empowered Ice Lance spells a 20% chance to apply Winter's Chill, increasing the target's damage taken from your next Cone of Cold by 20% and it gains an additional 7% of your spell damage, stacking up to 5 times.
talents.desc_max: Gives your Frostbolt and Fingers of Frost empowered Ice Lance spells a 100% chance to apply Winter's Chill, increasing the target's damage taken from your next Cone of Cold by 20% and it gains an additional 7% of your spell damage, stacking up to 5 times.

talents.name: Ice Barrier
talents.desc_rank1: Shield yourself, absorbing (448 + Frost Spell Power * 0.11) damage and increasing your Frost damage by 15% for 1 min. While shielded, your Frost damage is increased by an additional 5% and you do not lose casting time when you take damage.
talents.desc_max: Shield yourself, absorbing (448 + Frost Spell Power * 0.11) damage and increasing your Frost damage by 15% for 1 min. While shielded, your Frost damage is increased by an additional 5% and you do not lose casting time when you take damage.
